name: Majirori! ~Shokushu de H de Hakudaku Mamire~
original_name: まじろりっ!～触手でHで白濁まみれ～
source:
Town gets targeted by a devil. Little girl receives a magic wand and confronts the villain and his tentacle beasts. The fate of this town is entrusted to a little girl. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
城镇成为恶魔的目标。小女孩收到了一根魔杖，并对抗恶棍和他的触手野兽。这个小镇的命运被托付给了一个小女孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
